expectations.text: Anchors the security-safeguards penalty to Section 8(5) with the Rs 250 crore Schedule tier
expectations.evidence: "reasonable security safeguards ... Section 8(5): up to Rs 250 crore"

expectations.text: States the breach-notification failure tier of Rs 200 crore
expectations.evidence: "Failure to give the Board or affected Data Principals notice of a personal data breach - Section 8(6): up to Rs 200 crore"

expectations.text: States voluntary-undertaking breach is Section 32 with the penalty capped at the extent applicable to the underlying breach, not a flat Rs 50 crore
expectations.evidence: "Breach of a voluntary undertaking accepted by the Board - Section 32(3): up to the extent applicable to the breach in respect of which the undertaking was given"

expectations.text: States Rs 50 crore is the residual tier for other breaches
expectations.evidence: "Residuary: breach of any other provision of the Act or Rules - up to Rs 50 crore"

expectations.text: Lists Section 33(2) factors consistent with the statute (nature/gravity/duration, type of data, repetition, gain or loss avoided, mitigation, proportionality and deterrence, likely impact of the penalty) without invented factors
expectations.evidence: Distorts the statutory factors: "proportionality of the penalty to the person's ability to pay" and "the effect of the penalty on other relevant points" are not statutory factors; the statute's proportionate-and-effective (observance/deterrence) factor is misstated
